record.body:
## Problem

orchestra mixes work planning, dispatch and host code in one package.

## Approach

Move modules to orchestra.score, orchestra.conductor and orchestra.stage by the import graph, move module files, add tests/test_boundaries.py.

## Exit criteria

Full suite and tests/test_boundaries.py pass.

payload.title: Split orchestra into score, conductor and stage
